description: This file declares the interface for a factory class that creates IPC media pipeline capabilities objects within the Rialto client namespace. It includes licensing information, include guards, and class declarations for creating and retrieving media pipeline capabilities instances for IPC.

classes.name: IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpcFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating IPC media pipeline capabilities objects, providing methods to instantiate and retrieve singleton instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineCapabilitiesIpc
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create and return a unique pointer to an IMediaPipelineCapabilities object for IPC.
